items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: that was the name of the band, Happy Galloway's band... He had a barber shop on here on, on Baltimore between Pardis and Lafayette.

ctx.x: I heard somebody call him Happy Galloway.

Oh, he had, uh, well, that was, uh, that was the name of the band, Happy Galloway's band. Oh, I see. Because, see, it was his band. It went by his name. He had a barber shop on here on, on Baltimore between Pardis and Lafayette. He had a barber shop.
He played bass violin. Seems like somebody once called him Happy Galloway. Yes, that's right.
